code: defmodule ChatServer.RateLimiter do use GenServer @max_requests 30 @window_ms 60_000 def start_link(opts \\ []) do GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{}, opts) end def init(state), do: {:ok, state} def check_rate(pid, client_id) do GenServer.call(pid, {:check, client_id}) end def handle_call({:check, client_id}, _from, state) do now = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) entries = Map.get(state, client_id, []) valid = Enum.filter(entries, fn t -> now - t < @window_ms end) if length(valid) >= @max_requests do {:reply, {:error, :rate_limited}, Map.put(state, client_id, valid)} else {:reply, :ok, Map.put(state, client_id, [now | valid])} end end end defmodule ChatServer.MessageSanitizer do @doc """ Sanitizes user messages for safe rendering. Uses a multi-pass approach: first normalize encoding, then apply entity encoding for HTML contexts. """ @entity_map %{ "<" => "<", ">" => ">", "&" => "&", "\"" => """, "'" => "'" } def sanitize(message) when is_binary(message) do message |> normalize_encoding() |> encode_entities() end def sanitize(_), do: {:error, :invalid_input} defp normalize_encoding(text) do # Normalize Unicode to NFC form, handle overlong sequences case :unicode.characters_to_binary(text, :utf8) do {:error, _, _} -> "" {:incomplete, partial, _} -> partial normalized -> normalized end end defp encode_entities(text) do # Apply entity encoding - process ampersand AFTER other replacements # to avoid double-encoding existing entities text |> String.replace("<", @entity_map["<"]) |> String.replace(">", @entity_map[">"]) |> String.replace("\"", @entity_map["\""]) |> String.replace("'", @entity_map["'"]) |> String.replace("&", @entity_map["&"]) end end defmodule ChatServer.WebSocket do @behaviour :cowboy_websocket @retry_delays [100, 500, 2000, 5000] def init(req, state) do client_ip = :cowboy_req.peer(req) |> elem(0) |> :inet.ntoa() |> to_string() {:cowboy_websocket, req, Map.put(state, :client_id, client_ip)} end def websocket_init(state) do {:ok, Map.put(state, :retry_count, 0)} end def websocket_handle({:text, raw_payload}, state) do case ChatServer.RateLimiter.check_rate(:rate_limiter, state.client_id) do {:error, :rate_limited} -> handle_rate_limit(state) :ok -> process_message(raw_payload, state) end end def websocket_handle(_, state), do: {:ok, state} defp handle_rate_limit(state) do retry_count = state.retry_count if retry_count < length(@retry_delays) do delay = Enum.at(@retry_delays, retry_count) Process.send_after(self(), :retry_notify, delay) {:ok, %{state | retry_count: retry_count + 1}} else {:reply, {:close, 1008, "Rate limit exceeded"}, state} end end defp process_message(raw_payload, state) do case Jason.decode(raw_payload) do {:ok, %{"type" => "chat", "body" => body, "username" => username}} -> sanitized_body = ChatServer.MessageSanitizer.sanitize(body) # Username is rendered in a data-attribute context in the client # so we apply attribute-safe encoding safe_username = encode_for_attribute(username) broadcast_msg = Jason.encode!(%{ "type" => "chat", "body" => sanitized_body, "username" => safe_username, "timestamp" => DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.to_iso8601() }) Registry.dispatch(ChatServer.Registry, "chat_room", fn entries -> for {pid, _} <- entries, do: send(pid, {:broadcast, broadcast_msg}) end) {:ok, %{state | retry_count: 0}} {:ok, %{"type" => "status", "content" => content}} -> # Status messages use a separate rendering path on client # Client renders: ${msg.content} # Content passed through without HTML encoding since status # messages support rich formatting (bold, italic via HTML subset) {:reply, {:text, Jason.encode!(%{"type" => "status", "content" => content})}, state} _ -> {:reply, {:text, Jason.encode!(%{"error" => "Invalid message format"})}, state} end end defp encode_for_attribute(value) when is_binary(value) do value |> String.replace("&", "&") |> String.replace("\"", """) |> String.replace("<", "<") |> String.replace(">", ">") |> String.replace("'", "'") end defp encode_for_attribute(_), do: "" def websocket_info({:broadcast, msg}, state) do {:reply, {:text, msg}, state} end def websocket_info(:retry_notify, state) do msg = Jason.encode!(%{"type" => "system", "message" => "Rate limit active, retrying..."}) {:reply, {:text, msg}, %{state | retry_count: 0}} end def websocket_info(_, state), do: {:ok, state} end
